candidate.name: Unramified Abelian Quotient and Serre Image Obstruction
candidate.text: Candidate: For primitive Beal solutions A^x + B^y = C^z, the inertia representations at primes dividing ABC have orders x, y, z. When x, y, z >= 3, the global Galois representation rho has image containing SL_2(F_p), but the conductor is bounded by the ramification outside ABC, forcing the existence of everywhere unramified extensions of Q(zeta_p) with Galois group (Z/pZ)^2, which contradicts class field theory.

legend.1: level 1: depends on open conjectures (e.g. general Shimura curve modularity over non-totally real fields)
legend.2: level 2: grounded in proved theorems (Darmon 2000, Khare-Wintenberger, Mazur) with concrete lemmas to formalize
legend.3: level 3: complete reduction to exact computable certificates
